about.title: About This Project
about.subtitle: This interactive platform demonstrates how BMW's Digital Motor Electronics (DME) system works with various sensors and actuators to control modern engines.
about.educationalText: This project focuses on the BMW B58 engine, showcasing the relationship between input sensors (MAF, MAP, O2, Coolant) and output actuators (Throttle Body). Each component includes detailed technical information about its function, operation principles, common variations, and healthy operating ranges.
about.feature1: Interactive engine diagram with clickable sensor locations
about.feature2: Detailed technical specifications for each sensor
about.feature4: Dark mode support for comfortable viewing

maf.name: Mass Air Flow (MAF)
maf.function: Measures the mass of air entering the intake to calculate precise fuel injection quantity.
maf.howItWorks: A heated film or wire is cooled by incoming air. The DME measures the electrical current required to maintain the wire's temperature, which correlates to air mass.
maf.healthyRange: Idle: 3.5 - 4.5 g/s (approx 0.6V - 1.0V) | WOT: Increases linearly with RPM

map.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP)
map.function: Measures vacuum or positive boost pressure inside the intake manifold to determine engine load.
map.howItWorks: Uses a piezo-resistive crystal that changes electrical resistance based on pressure deflection.
map.healthyRange: Idle (Vacuum): ~0.3-0.5 bar absolute | Boost (N54): Up to 2.5 bar absolute (Voltage: 0.5V to 4.5V)
variations: T-MAP (Temperature + Pressure, used in Turbo N54/N55)

o2_pre.name: Pre-Catalytic O2 Sensor
o2_pre.function: Monitors raw exhaust gas to manage engine fueling (Closed Loop).
o2_pre.howItWorks: A wideband sensor (LSU) that provides a precise Lambda value to the DME.

o2_post.name: Post-Catalytic O2 Sensor
o2_post.function: Verifies the efficiency of the catalytic converter.
o2_post.howItWorks: A narrowband sensor that expects to see a steady oxygen level after the catalyst has done its job.
o2_post.healthyRange: Steady 0.6V to 0.7V once the catalyst is at operating temperature.

throttle.name: Electronic Throttle Body
throttle.function: Controls the volume of air entering the engine based on pedal position and DME torque requests.
throttle.howItWorks: DME sends a PWM signal to a DC motor to open the plate. Dual potentiometers (TPS 1 & 2) verify the position.
throttle.healthyRange: TPS 1: 0.5V (Closed) -> 4.5V (WOT) | TPS 2: Inverted signal for safety redundancy

coolant.name: Coolant Temperature Sensor
coolant.function: Measures engine temperature for cold-start enrichment, fan control, and safety limits.
coolant.howItWorks: NTC Thermistor (Negative Temperature Coefficient) - Resistance drops as temperature rises.
